import collections
import math

int parse_integer(string text)
    return int(text)

int cents(string text)
    parts := text.split(".")
    return 100 * parse_integer(parts[0]) + parse_integer(parts[1])

string money(int amount)
    return "{amount / 100}.{amount % 100:02.}"

string clock_text(int minute)
    elapsed := minute + 660
    return "{elapsed / 60:02.}:{elapsed % 60:02.}"

int rounded(int amount, int rate)
    return (amount * rate + 50) / 100

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

string[] courses()
    return ["DRINK", "STARTER", "MAIN", "DESSERT"]

string[] station_names()
    return ["GRILL", "FRY", "COLD", "BAR"]

int | error named_index(const string[] names, string name, string kind)
    for: 0 <= index < int(#names)
        if names[index] == name
            return index
    return error("unknown {kind} {name}")

class Table(int number, int seats)
    check := -1

class Server(string name)
    parties := 0
    sales := 0
    tips := 0

class Waiting(string name, int size, int joined)
class MenuItem(string name, int station, int prep, int price, int course)
    stock := -1
    served := 0

class Check(string party, int size, int table, int server, int seated)
    int[] lines := []
    paid := 0
    discount := 0
    closed := false

class Order(int number, int check, int seat, int item, int quantity, int station, int prep, int unit_price, int course)
    state := "ORDERED"
    comp := ""
    fired := 0
    ready := 0
    started := false

class Station(string name, int capacity)
    down := false
    int[] queue := []
    int[] tickets := []
    remakes := 0

class Amounts(int subtotal, int discount, int service, int tax, int total)
class SeatBill(int seat, int subtotal, int discount, int service, int tax, int total)
class State()
    minute := 0
    Table[] tables := []
    Server[] servers := []
    Waiting[] waiting := []
    MenuItem[] menu := []
    Check[] checks := []
    Order[] orders := []
    stations := [Station("GRILL", 1), Station("FRY", 1), Station("COLD", 1), Station("BAR", 2)]
    happy_rate := 0
    happy_end := 0
    covers := 0
    parties := 0
    turns := 0
    stay := 0
    sales := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    totals := Amounts(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    cash := 0
    card := 0
    tips := 0
    comps := 0
    comp_amount := 0
    voids := 0

int table_id(const State state, int table_number)
    for: 0 <= index < int(#state.tables)
        if state.tables[index].number == table_number
            return index
    return -1

int item_id(const State state, string name)
    for: 0 <= index < int(#state.menu)
        if state.menu[index].name == name
            return index
    return -1

int | error occupied_check(const State state, int table_number)
    index := table_id(state, table_number)
    if index < 0
        return error("unknown table {table_number}")
    if state.tables[index].check < 0
        return error("table {table_number} is free")
    return state.tables[index].check

int | error order_id(const State state, int order_number)
    if not (1 <= order_number <= int(#state.orders))
        return error("unknown line {order_number}")
    return order_number - 1

void | error unlocked(const State state, int check_index)
    check := state.checks[check_index]
    if check.paid > 0
        return error("check for table {state.tables[check.table].number} is locked")
    return void

void | error modifiable(const State state, int index)
    order := state.orders[index]
    if order.state == "VOID"
        return error("#{order.number} is void")
    if state.checks[order.check].closed
        return error("#{order.number} is on a closed check")
    return try unlocked(state, order.check)

int[] active_lines(const State state, int check_index)
    return [for index := state.checks[check_index].lines[] if state.orders[index].state != "VOID" then index]

void | error fully_served(const State state, int check_index)
    pending := [for index := active_lines(state, check_index)[] if state.orders[index].state != "SERVED" then index]
    if #pending > 0
        table_number := state.tables[state.checks[check_index].table].number
        return error("table {table_number} has {#pending} unserved items")
    return void

int order_amount(const Order order)
    return if order.comp == "" then order.unit_price * order.quantity else 0

Amounts check_amounts(const State state, int check_index)
    check := state.checks[check_index]
    amounts := [for index := active_lines(state, check_index)[] then order_amount(state.orders[index])]
    subtotal := amounts.sum()
    discount := rounded(subtotal, check.discount)
    discounted := subtotal - discount
    service := if check.size >= 6 then rounded(discounted, 18) else 0
    tax := rounded(discounted, 8)
    return Amounts(subtotal, discount, service, tax, discounted + service + tax)

int[] allocate(const int[] amounts, int rate)
    shares := amounts * rate / 100
    remainders := amounts * rate % 100
    extras := rounded(amounts.sum(), rate) - shares.sum()
    for: 0 <= extra < extras
        largest := remainders.max()
        for: 0 <= index < int(#amounts)
            if remainders[index] == largest
                shares[index] += 1
                remainders[index] = -1
                break
    return shares

SeatBill[] seat_bills(const State state, int check_index)
    lines := active_lines(state, check_index)
    distinct<int> unique_seats
    for index := lines[]
        .unique_seats.add(state.orders[index].seat)
    seats := unique_seats.sorted()
    int[] subtotals := []
    for seat := seats[]
        amounts := [for index := lines[] if state.orders[index].seat == seat then order_amount(state.orders[index])]
        subtotals = subtotals.append(amounts.sum())
    discounts := allocate(subtotals, state.checks[check_index].discount)
    discounted := subtotals - discounts
    services := allocate(discounted, if state.checks[check_index].size >= 6 then 18 else 0)
    taxes := allocate(discounted, 8)
    SeatBill[] result := []
    for: 0 <= index < int(#seats)
        result = result.append(SeatBill(seats[index], subtotals[index], discounts[index], services[index], taxes[index], discounted[index] + services[index] + taxes[index]))
    return result

int server_load(const State state, int server_index)
    checks := [for check := state.checks[] if not check.closed and check.server == server_index then check]
    return int(#checks)

int select_table(const State state, int size)
    selected := -1
    for: 0 <= index < int(#state.tables)
        table := state.tables[index]
        if table.check < 0 and table.seats >= size
            if selected < 0 or table.seats < state.tables[selected].seats or (table.seats == state.tables[selected].seats and table.number < state.tables[selected].number)
                selected = index
    return selected

int seat_party(State &state, string name, int size, int table_index)
    server_index := 0
    load := server_load(state, 0)
    for: 1 <= index < int(#state.servers)
        candidate := server_load(state, index)
        if candidate < load
            load = candidate
            server_index = index
    state.tables[table_index].check = int(#state.checks)
    state.checks = state.checks.append(Check(name, size, table_index, server_index, state.minute))
    state.covers += size
    state.parties += 1
    state.servers[server_index].parties += 1
    return server_index

void seat_waiting(State &state)
    position := 0
    while position < int(#state.waiting)
        party := state.waiting[position]
        table_index := select_table(state, party.size)
        if table_index < 0
            position += 1
        else
            state.waiting = state.waiting[0:<position].concat(state.waiting[position + 1:])
            server_index := seat_party(&state, party.name, party.size, table_index)
            emit("SEATED {party.name} {party.size} table {state.tables[table_index].number} server {state.servers[server_index].name} waited {state.minute - party.joined}")

void close_check(State &state, int check_index)
    check := state.checks[check_index]
    amounts := check_amounts(state, check_index)
    for index := active_lines(state, check_index)[]
        order := state.orders[index]
        state.sales[order.course] += order_amount(order)
    state.totals.subtotal += amounts.subtotal
    state.totals.discount += amounts.discount
    state.totals.service += amounts.service
    state.totals.tax += amounts.tax
    state.totals.total += amounts.total
    state.turns += 1
    state.stay += state.minute - check.seated
    state.servers[check.server].sales += amounts.total
    state.checks[check_index].closed = true
    state.tables[check.table].check = -1
    emit("FREE table {state.tables[check.table].number} {check.party} stayed {state.minute - check.seated}")
    seat_waiting(&state)

int[] cooking_lines(const State state, int station_index)
    return [for order := state.orders[] if order.station == station_index and order.state == "COOKING" then order.number - 1]

void start_cooking(State &state, int station_index, int minute)
    &station := &state.stations[station_index]
    count := int(#cooking_lines(state, station_index))
    while not station.down and #station.queue > 0 and count < station.capacity
        index := station.queue[0]
        station.queue = station.queue[1:]
        state.orders[index].state = "COOKING"
        state.orders[index].started = true
        state.orders[index].ready = minute + state.orders[index].prep
        count += 1

void start_all(State &state, int minute)
    for: 0 <= index < 4
        start_cooking(&state, index, minute)

void advance_time(State &state, int minutes)
    ending := state.minute + minutes
    emit("TICK " + clock_text(ending))
    while true
        finishes := [for order := state.orders[] if order.state == "COOKING" then order.ready]
        if #finishes == 0
            break
        completed := finishes.min()
        if completed > ending
            break
        for: 0 <= station_index < 4
            for index := cooking_lines(state, station_index)[]
                &order := &state.orders[index]
                if order.ready == completed
                    order.state = "READY"
                    state.stations[station_index].tickets = state.stations[station_index].tickets.append(completed - order.fired)
                    table_number := state.tables[state.checks[order.check].table].number
                    emit("READY {clock_text(completed)} {state.stations[station_index].name} #{order.number} {state.menu[order.item].name} x{order.quantity} table {table_number} seat {order.seat}")
        start_all(&state, completed)
    state.minute = ending

string line_numbers(const int[] indices)
    labels := [for index := indices[] then "#{index + 1}"]
    return if #labels == 0 then "-" else labels.join(" ")

void show_bill(const State state, int check_index)
    check := state.checks[check_index]
    amounts := check_amounts(state, check_index)
    emit("BILL table {state.tables[check.table].number} {check.party} guests {check.size}")
    for seat := seat_bills(state, check_index)[]
        emit("SEAT {seat.seat} {money(seat.subtotal)}")
        for index := active_lines(state, check_index)[]
            order := state.orders[index]
            if order.seat == seat.seat
                comp := if order.comp == "" then "" else " COMP " + order.comp
                emit("#{order.number} {state.menu[order.item].name} x{order.quantity} {money(order_amount(order))}{comp}")
    emit("SUBTOTAL " + money(amounts.subtotal))
    if check.discount != 0
        emit("DISCOUNT {check.discount}% {money(amounts.discount)}")
    if check.size >= 6
        emit("SERVICE " + money(amounts.service))
    emit("TAX " + money(amounts.tax))
    emit("TOTAL " + money(amounts.total))
    if check.paid > 0
        emit("PAID " + money(check.paid))
        emit("DUE " + money(amounts.total - check.paid))

void show_kitchen(const State state)
    emit("KITCHEN " + clock_text(state.minute))
    for: 0 <= station_index < 4
        station := state.stations[station_index]
        cooking := cooking_lines(state, station_index)
        if #cooking == 2 and state.orders[cooking[0]].ready > state.orders[cooking[1]].ready
            cooking = cooking[::-1]
        labels := [for index := cooking[] then "#{index + 1}@{clock_text(state.orders[index].ready)}"]
        active := if #labels == 0 then "-" else labels.join(" ")
        emit("{station.name} " + (if station.down then "down" else "up") + " cooking {active} queue {line_numbers(station.queue)}")

void show_floor(const State state)
    free_tables := [for table := state.tables[] if table.check < 0 then table]
    emit("FLOOR {clock_text(state.minute)} free {#free_tables} seated {int(#state.tables) - int(#free_tables)} waiting {#state.waiting}")
    numbers := [for table := state.tables[] then table.number]
    for table_number := numbers.sorted()[]
        table := state.tables[table_id(state, table_number)]
        line := "table {table.number} seats {table.seats} "
        if table.check < 0
            line += "free"
        else
            check := state.checks[table.check]
            amounts := check_amounts(state, table.check)
            line += "{check.party} guests {check.size} server {state.servers[check.server].name} since {clock_text(check.seated)} items {#active_lines(state, table.check)} total {money(amounts.total)}"
            if check.paid > 0
                line += " paid " + money(check.paid)
        emit(line)
    for: 0 <= position < int(#state.waiting)
        party := state.waiting[position]
        emit("WAITING {position + 1} {party.name} {party.size} since {clock_text(party.joined)}")

void show_report(const State state)
    emit("REPORT " + clock_text(state.minute))
    emit("COVERS {state.covers} parties {state.parties}")
    emit("TURNS {state.turns} avg_stay " + (if state.turns == 0 then "-" else string(state.stay / state.turns)))
    emit("SALES DRINK {money(state.sales[0])} STARTER {money(state.sales[1])} MAIN {money(state.sales[2])} DESSERT {money(state.sales[3])}")
    Amounts totals := state.totals
    emit("TOTALS subtotal {money(totals.subtotal)} discount {money(totals.discount)} service {money(totals.service)} tax {money(totals.tax)} total {money(totals.total)}")
    emit("PAYMENTS cash {money(state.cash)} card {money(state.card)} tips {money(state.tips)}")
    emit("COMPS {state.comps} {money(state.comp_amount)} VOIDS {state.voids}")
    names := [for item := state.menu[] if item.served > 0 then item.name]
    int[] ranking := []
    for name := names.sorted()[]
        item := item_id(state, name)
        ranking = ranking.append(item)
        position := int(#ranking) - 1
        while position > 0 and state.menu[ranking[position - 1]].served < state.menu[item].served
            ranking[position] = ranking[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        ranking[position] = item
    for: 0 <= rank < math.min(3, int(#ranking))
        item := state.menu[ranking[rank]]
        emit("TOP {rank + 1} {item.name} {item.served}")
    for station := state.stations[]
        measures := "avg - max -"
        if #station.tickets > 0
            measures = "avg {station.tickets.sum() / int(#station.tickets)} max {station.tickets.max()}"
        emit("{station.name} tickets {#station.tickets} {measures} remakes {station.remakes}")
    for: 0 <= index < int(#state.servers)
        server := state.servers[index]
        emit("SERVER {server.name} tables {server_load(state, index)} parties {server.parties} sales {money(server.sales)} tips {money(server.tips)}")

void | error command(State &state, const string[] words)
    verb := words[0]
    course_names := courses()
    stations := station_names()
    if verb == "TABLE"
        table_number := parse_integer(words[1])
        if table_id(state, table_number) >= 0
            return error("table {table_number} already exists")
        state.tables = state.tables.append(Table(table_number, parse_integer(words[2])))
        emit("TABLE {table_number} seats {words[2]}")
        seat_waiting(&state)
    elif verb == "STAFF"
        for server := state.servers[]
            if server.name == words[1]
                return error(words[1] + " is already on duty")
        state.servers = state.servers.append(Server(words[1]))
        emit("STAFF " + words[1])
    elif verb == "SEAT"
        name := words[1]
        size := parse_integer(words[2])
        for check := state.checks[]
            if not check.closed and check.party == name
                return error("{name} is already seated at table {state.tables[check.table].number}")
        for party := state.waiting[]
            if party.name == name
                return error(name + " is already waiting")
        suitable := [for table := state.tables[] if table.seats >= size then table]
        if #suitable == 0
            return error("no table for party of {size}")
        if #state.servers == 0
            return error("no server on duty")
        table_index := select_table(state, size)
        if table_index < 0
            state.waiting = state.waiting.append(Waiting(name, size, state.minute))
            emit("WAIT {name} {size} position {#state.waiting}")
        else
            server_index := seat_party(&state, name, size, table_index)
            emit("SEAT {name} {size} table {state.tables[table_index].number} server {state.servers[server_index].name}")
    elif verb == "CANCEL"
        found := -1
        for: 0 <= position < int(#state.waiting)
            if state.waiting[position].name == words[1]
                found = position
                break
        if found < 0
            return error(words[1] + " is not waiting")
        party := state.waiting[found]
        state.waiting = state.waiting[0:<found].concat(state.waiting[found + 1:])
        emit("CANCEL {party.name} {party.size} waited {state.minute - party.joined}")
    elif verb == "MOVE"
        source := table_id(state, parse_integer(words[1]))
        destination := table_id(state, parse_integer(words[2]))
        if source < 0
            return error("unknown table " + words[1])
        if destination < 0
            return error("unknown table " + words[2])
        if state.tables[source].check < 0
            return error("table " + words[1] + " is free")
        if state.tables[destination].check >= 0
            return error("table " + words[2] + " is occupied")
        check_index := state.tables[source].check
        check := state.checks[check_index]
        if state.tables[destination].seats < check.size
            return error("table {words[2]} is too small for {check.party}")
        state.tables[source].check = -1
        state.tables[destination].check = check_index
        state.checks[check_index].table = destination
        emit("MOVE {check.party} table {words[1]} -> {words[2]}")
        seat_waiting(&state)
    elif verb == "MENU"
        station := try named_index(stations, words[2], "station")
        course := try named_index(course_names, words[5], "course")
        item := item_id(state, words[1])
        action := "ADD"
        if item < 0
            state.menu = state.menu.append(MenuItem(words[1], station, parse_integer(words[3]), cents(words[4]), course))
        else
            action = "UPDATE"
            state.menu[item].station = station
            state.menu[item].prep = parse_integer(words[3])
            state.menu[item].price = cents(words[4])
            state.menu[item].course = course
        emit("MENU {action} {words[1]} {words[2]} {words[3]} {money(cents(words[4]))} {words[5]}")
    elif verb == "STOCK"
        item := item_id(state, words[1])
        if item < 0
            return error("unknown item " + words[1])
        state.menu[item].stock = parse_integer(words[2])
        emit("STOCK {words[1]} {words[2]}")
    elif verb == "HAPPY"
        state.happy_rate = parse_integer(words[1])
        state.happy_end = state.minute + parse_integer(words[2])
        emit("HAPPY {state.happy_rate}% until {clock_text(state.happy_end)}")
    elif verb == "ITEMS"
        emit("ITEMS {#state.menu}")
        for: 0 <= course < 4
            names := [for item := state.menu[] if item.course == course then item.name]
            for name := names.sorted()[]
                item := state.menu[item_id(state, name)]
                stock := if item.stock < 0 then "-" else string(item.stock)
                emit("{course_names[course]} {item.name} {stations[item.station]} {item.prep} {money(item.price)} {stock}")
    elif verb == "TICK"
        advance_time(&state, parse_integer(words[1]))
    elif verb == "STATION"
        station_index := try named_index(stations, words[1], "station")
        down := words[2] == "DOWN"
        if down and state.stations[station_index].down
            return error("station " + words[1] + " is already down")
        if not down and not state.stations[station_index].down
            return error("station " + words[1] + " is not down")
        state.stations[station_index].down = down
        if not down
            start_cooking(&state, station_index, state.minute)
        emit("STATION {words[1]} {words[2]}")
    elif verb == "RUSH" or verb == "REMAKE" or verb == "VOID" or verb == "COMP" or verb == "TRANSFER"
        index := try order_id(state, parse_integer(words[1]))
        order := state.orders[index]
        check := state.checks[order.check]
        table_number := state.tables[check.table].number
        item_name := state.menu[order.item].name
        if verb == "RUSH"
            if order.state != "QUEUED"
                return error("#{order.number} is not queued")
            remaining := [for queued := state.stations[order.station].queue[] if queued != index then queued]
            state.stations[order.station].queue = [index].concat(remaining)
            emit("RUSH #{order.number} {stations[order.station]}")
        elif verb == "REMAKE"
            if check.closed
                return error("#{order.number} is on a closed check")
            if order.state != "READY" and order.state != "SERVED"
                return error("#{order.number} is not ready or served")
            state.orders[index].state = "QUEUED"
            state.orders[index].fired = state.minute
            state.stations[order.station].queue = [index].concat(state.stations[order.station].queue)
            state.stations[order.station].remakes += 1
            emit("REMAKE #{order.number} {item_name} {stations[order.station]}")
            start_cooking(&state, order.station, state.minute)
        elif verb == "VOID"
            if order.state == "VOID"
                return error("#{order.number} is already void")
            if order.started
                return error("#{order.number} has already started")
            if order.state == "QUEUED"
                state.stations[order.station].queue = [for queued := state.stations[order.station].queue[] if queued != index then queued]
            state.orders[index].state = "VOID"
            if state.menu[order.item].stock >= 0
                state.menu[order.item].stock += order.quantity
            state.voids += 1
            emit("VOID #{order.number} {item_name} x{order.quantity}")
        else
            try modifiable(state, index)
            if verb == "COMP"
                if order.comp != ""
                    return error("#{order.number} is already comped")
                amount := order_amount(order)
                state.comps += 1
                state.comp_amount += amount
                state.orders[index].comp = words[2]
                emit("COMP #{order.number} {item_name} {money(amount)} {words[2]}")
            else
                seat := parse_integer(words[2])
                if seat > check.size
                    return error("seat {seat} out of range for table {table_number}")
                if seat == order.seat
                    return error("#{order.number} is already on seat {seat}")
                state.orders[index].seat = seat
                emit("TRANSFER #{order.number} seat {order.seat} -> {seat}")
    elif verb == "KITCHEN"
        show_kitchen(state)
    elif verb == "FLOOR"
        show_floor(state)
    elif verb == "REPORT"
        show_report(state)
    else
        table_number := parse_integer(words[1])
        check_index := try occupied_check(state, table_number)
        check := state.checks[check_index]
        if verb == "ORDER"
            try unlocked(state, check_index)
            seat := parse_integer(words[2])
            if seat > check.size
                return error("seat {seat} out of range for table {table_number}")
            item := item_id(state, words[3])
            if item < 0
                return error("unknown item " + words[3])
            menu_item := state.menu[item]
            quantity := parse_integer(words[4])
            if menu_item.stock >= 0 and menu_item.stock < quantity
                return error("only {menu_item.stock} {menu_item.name} left")
            happy := menu_item.course == 0 and state.minute < state.happy_end
            price := menu_item.price - (if happy then rounded(menu_item.price, state.happy_rate) else 0)
            index := int(#state.orders)
            state.orders = state.orders.append(Order(index + 1, check_index, seat, item, quantity, menu_item.station, menu_item.prep, price, menu_item.course))
            state.checks[check_index].lines = state.checks[check_index].lines.append(index)
            emit("ORDER #{index + 1} table {table_number} seat {seat} {menu_item.name} x{quantity} {money(price * quantity)}" + (if happy then " HAPPY" else ""))
            if menu_item.stock >= 0
                state.menu[item].stock -= quantity
                if state.menu[item].stock == 0
                    emit("SOLDOUT " + menu_item.name)
        elif verb == "FIRE"
            course := try named_index(course_names, words[2], "course")
            selected := [for index := check.lines[] if state.orders[index].course == course and state.orders[index].state == "ORDERED" then index]
            if #selected == 0
                return error("nothing to fire for {words[2]} at table {table_number}")
            for: 1 <= earlier < course
                for index := check.lines[]
                    if state.orders[index].course == earlier and state.orders[index].state == "ORDERED"
                        return error("fire " + course_names[earlier] + " first")
            for index := selected[]
                &order := &state.orders[index]
                order.state = "QUEUED"
                order.fired = state.minute
                state.stations[order.station].queue = state.stations[order.station].queue.append(index)
            emit("FIRE table {table_number} {words[2]} {line_numbers(selected)}")
            start_all(&state, state.minute)
        elif verb == "SERVE"
            selected := [for index := check.lines[] if state.orders[index].state == "READY" then index]
            if #selected == 0
                return error("nothing ready for table {table_number}")
            for index := selected[]
                state.orders[index].state = "SERVED"
                state.menu[state.orders[index].item].served += state.orders[index].quantity
            emit("SERVE table {table_number} {line_numbers(selected)}")
        elif verb == "DISCOUNT"
            try unlocked(state, check_index)
            state.checks[check_index].discount = parse_integer(words[2])
            emit("DISCOUNT table {table_number} {words[2]}%")
        elif verb == "BILL"
            show_bill(state, check_index)
        elif verb == "SPLIT"
            amounts := check_amounts(state, check_index)
            due := amounts.total - check.paid
            if due == 0
                return error("nothing to split for table {table_number}")
            if words[2] == "EVEN"
                count := parse_integer(words[3])
                if count > check.size
                    return error("cannot split table {table_number} {count} ways")
                emit("SPLIT table {table_number} EVEN {count} due {money(due)}")
                for: 1 <= payer <= count
                    emit("PAYER {payer} {money(due / count + (if payer <= due % count then 1 else 0))}")
            else
                if check.paid > 0
                    return error("table {table_number} has payments")
                emit("SPLIT table {table_number} BYSEAT total {money(amounts.total)}")
                for seat := seat_bills(state, check_index)[]
                    emit("SEAT {seat.seat} subtotal {money(seat.subtotal)} discount {money(seat.discount)} service {money(seat.service)} tax {money(seat.tax)} total {money(seat.total)}")
        elif verb == "PAY" or verb == "CLOSE"
            if verb == "PAY" and words[2] != "CASH" and words[2] != "CARD"
                return error("unknown method " + words[2])
            try fully_served(state, check_index)
            amounts := check_amounts(state, check_index)
            due := amounts.total - check.paid
            if verb == "CLOSE"
                if due != 0
                    return error("table {table_number} still owes {money(due)}")
                close_check(&state, check_index)
            else
                if due == 0
                    return error("nothing to pay for table {table_number}")
                amount := cents(words[3])
                applied := math.min(amount, due)
                state.checks[check_index].paid += applied
                if words[2] == "CASH"
                    state.cash += applied
                else
                    state.card += applied
                if amount < due
                    emit("PAY table {table_number} {words[2]} {money(amount)} remaining {money(due - amount)}")
                else
                    label := if words[2] == "CASH" then "change" else "tip"
                    if words[2] == "CARD"
                        state.tips += amount - due
                        state.servers[check.server].tips += amount - due
                    emit("PAY table {table_number} {words[2]} {money(amount)} {label} {money(amount - due)}")
                    close_check(&state, check_index)
        else
            emit("STATUS table {table_number} {check.party} guests {check.size} since {clock_text(check.seated)}")
            for index := check.lines[]
                order := state.orders[index]
                line := "#{order.number} seat {order.seat} {state.menu[order.item].name} x{order.quantity} {course_names[order.course]} {order.state}"
                if order.state == "COOKING"
                    line += " until " + clock_text(order.ready)
                if order.comp != ""
                    line += " COMP " + order.comp
                emit(line)
    return void

state := State()
int count
scan(&count)
for: 0 <= index < count
    string line
    scan(&line)
    match command(&state, line.split(" "))
        void
            continue
        error problem
            emit("ERROR " + problem.message)
